scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api -c cyan,blue "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "pnpm api:dev"
scripts.dev:infra: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api -c cyan,blue "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "pnpm api:dev:infra"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/web build && ./apps/api/gradlew -p apps/api build && pnpm mcp:build
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/web test && ./apps/api/gradlew -p apps/api test && pnpm mcp:test
scripts.dev:mcp: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api,mcp -c cyan,blue,magenta "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "pnpm api:dev" "pnpm mcp:dev"
scripts.dev:openai: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api,mcp -c cyan,blue,magenta "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "pnpm api:dev:openai" "pnpm mcp:dev"
scripts.dev:infra:openai: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api,mcp -c cyan,blue,magenta "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "pnpm api:dev:infra:openai" "pnpm mcp:dev"
